findings: 2026-11-06: drafted for Mathematics 12 Unit 9 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: The book prints "Consider the function define by f(x) = \tan x with domain is the set ... and range is the set of all real numbers". It should read: "Consider the function defined by f(x) = \tan x, with domain the set \left\{x \mid x \in \mathbb{R},\ x \ne (2n+1)\frac{\pi}{2},\ n \in \mathbb{Z}\right\} and range the set of all real numbers." (Grammar only; the domain and range are correct.)
Book correction: The book prints "the line y = 2 intersect the graph"; it should be "the line y = 2 intersects the graph" (grammar only).

Book correction: The book prints "is also obtain by reflecting"; it should be "is also obtained by reflecting". It also prints "Observe that the graph of y = \tan x is symmetric about the line y = x". The graph of y = \tan x alone is not symmetric about y = x; the correct statement is that the graphs of y = \tan x (principal) and y = \tan^{-1} x are symmetric about the line y = x (mirror images of each other).
